## Working Alongside VPro Desktop

`vpro` is designed for dual-screen work alongside **VPro Desktop**. While VPro Desktop keeps your active project open in **FS882 Data Forms (6x4)**, **Universal Datasheet Grid**, or **3D Map**, `vpro` opens safe read-only connections to the exact same workspace directory (`vpro_data_dir()`) without file-locking conflicts.

```{r}
library(vpro)

# Check 2026 BECdb v13 + BCPlantTaxonomy v19 provenance
std <- vpro_standards()
std$verified
std$sources[, c("version", "archive_name")]
```

In a live VPro Desktop session, calling `vpro_connect()` with zero arguments reads your active settings from `vpro_config_dir()` and connects to your current project, Site Unit (`*_SU`), Hierarchy (`*_Hierarchy`), and Lump (`*_Lump`) tables in `vpro_data_dir()`. For reproducible examples and automated scripts, `vpro_connect("Sample")` opens the bundled `Sample` teaching project:

```{r}
ws <- vpro_connect("Sample")
ws
vpro_list_su(ws)
vpro_list_lumps(ws)
```

## Tidy Environment, Vegetation, and `LMH25 (2023)` Soil Readers

Plot identifiers (`PlotNumber`) are strictly preserved as text strings up to 7 characters (keeping leading zeroes such as `"00337"`), and VPro yes/no flags are normalized to R `logical` vectors:

```{r}
env <- vpro_env(ws, scope = "project")
head(env[, c("PlotNumber", "SiteUnit", "Zone", "SubZone", "MoistureRegime", "NutrientRegime", "Elevation", "Flag")])
```

`vpro_veg()` resolves `BCPlantTaxonomy v19` synonyms (`OldCode -> Code`), folds active `*_Lump` mappings with VPro's per-layer `99%` cover cap, and aggregates cover across `raw`, `abcd`, `lifeform`, or `total` strata:

```{r}
veg_abcd <- vpro_veg(ws, strata = "abcd", lump = TRUE, exclude_modifiers = TRUE)
head(veg_abcd)
```

`vpro_soil()` extracts humus and mineral horizons ordered according to *Land Management Handbook 25* (`LMH25`, 2023): upland organic horizons (`L`, `F`, `H`) are ordered upward from mineral contact (`UpperDepth DESC`), whereas wetland organic (`Of`, `Om`, `Oh`) and mineral (`A`, `B`, `C`, `R`, `W`) horizons are ordered downward (`UpperDepth ASC`):

```{r}
soil <- vpro_soil(ws)
head(soil$humus[, c("PlotNumber", "Horizon", "UpperDepth", "LowerDepth", "vonPost", "HorizonRegime")])
```

## Standards, Numeric Bounds, and `LMH25 (2023)` Quality Control Validation

Before running multivariate classification or publishing unit summaries, run `vpro_validate()` (with `checks = "all"`, `"compliance"`, or `"lmh25"`) to catch substrate sum discrepancies, inverted horizon depths, `vonPost` scale mismatches, out-of-range numeric or text-length bounds, and unlisted environment or species codes—matching the checks shown in **Forms -> Project Admin, QA & Merge**:

```{r}
lmh <- vpro_validate(ws, checks = "lmh25")
lmh$lmh25$summary

qa <- vpro_validate(ws)
head(qa$issues, 8)
```
